name: Clean process
condition: B3-B6 are flow meters for clean process lines: bodies are 304 or 316L stainless steel with DN15 to DN80 flange or threaded connections, and the output is 4-20 mA or pulse.
criteria: Choose 316L wetted parts where the medium or cleaning agent is aggressive.
Match the line size: DN15, DN50 and DN80 connections across B3-B6.
Match the output to the control system: 4-20 mA for analog loops, pulse for totalizers.
Record the body material and connection on the drawing for the next replacement.
cautions: A 304 body is not equivalent to 316L in corrosive service.
Flange and thread connections are not interchangeable on the same line.
Accuracy is given as percent of reading; check it at the actual flow, not at full scale.
seoTitle: Clean Process Lines: 316L Bodies and Flow Range
seoDescription: Clean process flow selection: choose 316L wetted parts, match the DN15 to DN80 connection and pick 4-20 mA or pulse output. A checklist for B3-B6 flow meters.

zh.name: 洁净工艺
zh.condition: B3–B6 为洁净工艺管路流量计：外壳为 304 或 316L 不锈钢，连接为 DN15 至 DN80 法兰或螺纹，输出 4–20 mA 或脉冲。
criteria: 介质或清洗剂有腐蚀性时优先选 316L 接液部件。
按管径选连接：B3–B6 覆盖 DN15、DN50 与 DN80。
输出按控制系统选：模拟回路用 4–20 mA，累积用脉冲。
把外壳材质与连接标注在图纸上，便于后续替换。
cautions: 腐蚀性工况下 304 外壳不等同于 316L。
法兰与螺纹连接在同一管路上不能互换。
精度按读数百分比给出，要在实际流量点而非满量程处核对。
zh.seoTitle: 洁净工艺选型：接液材质与流量范围如何确定
zh.seoDescription: 洁净工艺选型要点：腐蚀性介质优先选 316L 接液部件，连接按 DN15 至 DN80 法兰或螺纹核对，输出按控制系统选 4–20 mA 或脉冲；适用于 B3–B6 流量计。
